dz: 约翰·威克利夫(John Wickliffe)号飞船抵达查尔默斯港,搭载第一批苏格兰定居者前往新西兰的杜内丁. 奥塔戈省成立.
de: The ship John Wickliffe arrives at Port Chalmers carrying the first Scottish settlers for Dunedin, New Zealand. Otago province is founded.

te: A massive earthquake destroys the former capital Inwa of the Konbaung dynasty, present-day Myanmar.
dz: 一场大地震摧毁了今缅甸康保王朝的前都城仁和.

te: Battle and fall of city of Kalamata.
dz: 希腊独立战争：卡拉马塔市的战斗和陷落。
de: Greek War of Independence: Battle and fall of city of Kalamata.

dz: 探险家刘易斯和克拉克及其探索军团在穿越路易斯安那州采购公司并到达太平洋后,开始了他们艰苦的回家之行.
de: After traveling through the Louisiana Purchase and reaching the Pacific Ocean, explorers Lewis and Clark and their Corps of Discovery begin their arduous journey home.

dz: 俄罗斯沙皇保罗一世在圣迈克尔城堡的卧室内被剑击中，然后被勒死，最后被踩死。

te: The Peace of Longjumeau is signed, ending the second phase of the French Wars of Religion.
dz: "长朱莫之和"签署,结束了法国宗教战争第二阶段.

dz: 英国的瓦尔特姆修道院被投降给国王亨利八世,这是修道院解体期间最后一个被关闭的宗教社区.
de: Waltham Abbey in England is surrendered to King Henry VIII, the last religious community to be closed during the Dissolution of the Monasteries.

dz: 越南特兰王朝被废黜,历经一百七十五年的统治,由朝廷官员赫克·克·利出任.
de: The Trần dynasty of Vietnam is deposed, after one hundred and seventy-five years of rule, by Hồ Quý Ly, a court official.

t: 穆罕默德手下的穆斯林军队在乌胡德战役中遭遇了与克赖什人相对抗的失败.
te: The Muslim army under Muhammad suffers a defeat against the Quraysh in the battle of Uhud.
dz: 穆罕默德手下的穆斯林军队在乌胡德战役中遭遇了与克赖什人相对抗的失败.
